note: Sessions are tagged by the date range they fall in. Edit freely; 'stamps' pins single sessions.

projects.name: MuseLog: building the recorder
projects.summary: The multi-headband Android recorder itself, tested on the author's own head while it was written: raw EEG at 256 Hz, band powers, contact quality, optics and motion in one CSV per headband.

projects.name: Brain state in snow and cold
projects.summary: Wearable EEG with inertial sensing outdoors in winter; chirplet time-frequency analysis of the non-stationary dynamics during movement in snow, with the gyroscope used to suppress motion artefacts.

projects.name: Cold exposure, mini-golf and Cocaine Buzzkill
projects.summary: Field sessions around cold-water immersion: motor-cognitive putting before and after a plunge with the headband on, and the passthrough XR snowball game played at the lakeshore in winter with EEG mapped to the snowballs.

projects.name: Spring 2026 pilots
projects.summary: Shorter sittings with the headband while the analysis pipelines were built: caffeine and modality in study, water and the ear, early validation runs.

projects.name: The ear in water
projects.summary: Recordings with the headband at the water: what the ear electrodes pick up when the head meets the lake, and the optical channels' pulse.

projects.name: Eye as a Camera on a headset
projects.summary: The 2019 eye-as-a-camera method rebuilt on a Muse headband with an added occipital electrode and a Meta Quest 3S: words, colours and a sealed optotype read from the EEG; the ear as a microphone; an objective eye exam.

projects.name: Buzzkill after the cold plunge
projects.summary: Three sittings of the XR game, one warm and two after a plunge in Lake Ontario, recorded by the phone: what each sensor survives in the field (the optical pulse held; the dry EEG did not).

projects.name: Jobbing on the Sleep
projects.summary: Overnight recordings toward Mann's idea of working through sleep: a nap rig that watches the headband and logs what the sleeper does.
